sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Kér (no -k) is the third-person form, used when a waiter politely asks what YOU would like: Mit kér? = 'What would you like?'. Kérek (with -k) is what YOU say back.
Don't mix them up: a waiter says Mit kér?, and you reply Kérek kenyeret — never Kér kenyeret for yourself.
